additional_info.subject: ID0431320-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2 / R6 313065117088] Shutdown -> charger overheat CRM:02698000253
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi, good afternoon. How are you?
It seems that the BT3 is not behaving properly.
Either we have a loose connection here:
Or the sensor is indeed faulty and needs replacement.
Please schedule a site visit and measure the resistance by removing both cables from the KF6, if it's the value is not correct with SCB then please check if the cables are properly attached.
If the sensor is not reading correctly, please replace it.
I send this to your queue.
Thanks and have a nice week ahead.
Best regards,
Francisco
